extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: pontoon houseboat with cabin, porch and roof terrace, approx. 10.2 x 4.4 x 6.1 m (L x W x H incl. parasol)
extras.notes: bow (porch) faces -Y; stands on its two pontoons at z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 0.24 m: blue stripe above the antifouling); houseboat_parasol is a separate object with origin at its foot; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text, no name

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
